title: Monte Carlo Probability Workbench
summary: This visual holds the data of the Monte Carlo Probability Workbench. Its page is now 4 notebooks of yujieteo/site. play/mclaws/ has the laws, the limits, the theory and the glossary. play/mcmodels/ has the models, the methods, the datasets, the groups and the guided interview. play/mcchains/ has the Markov chain, sequential and quasi-Monte Carlo lab and the rare-event lab. play/mcphysics/ has the statistical-physics lab. The catalogue holds 60 entries of laws, copulas and processes, 60 behaviour experiments, 180 workflows and 12 examples of custom law inputs. It also holds 9 methods, 24 theory panels, a glossary of 363 terms, 5 public-domain datasets and the measured limits. This folder keeps the 12 data files and their Rust builder, which writes raw.json from them.
